note: Human rulings that the reconciliation report cannot safely infer. Everything here is a claim that two names are the same movement, or that a token means another token — the kind of judgement a string comparison must never make on its own.

equipment_new.note: Tokens with no equivalent in content.equipment. `tier` is a PROPOSAL for review: athlete_selectable becomes an onboarding control, derived_common is implied by a gym rather than ticked, specialized needs deliberate opt-in and never a backfill.

bucket_normalisation.note: The 50/25/25 bucket answers 'what kind of exposure is this'. Anchor-ness answers 'how should the progression engine treat it' and belongs in progression_class. Six values collapse to the methodology's three; the anchor half of each label is carried out separately as a proposed progression_class.

renames.note: Proposed RENAME_EXISTING: the sheet's preferred display name for a movement the library already has. The id is preserved; only the canonical name changes, and the old name becomes an alias.

keep_existing.note: Live exercises absent from the sheet that are NOT deprecation candidates. Cardio, mobility and skill work is out of scope for a strength vocabulary, so its absence carries no signal at all. The six named by product are kept deliberately: five are endpoints in the substitution graph and push_press -> incline_db_press is what makes HYROX Push A reachable without a barbell.
